answer: Concrete brake: each identity posts a non-recoverable bond, and its weight in any quorum grows only after weeks of independently verified work, while an overlap detector watching transaction graphs slashes the whole bond when two accounts behave as one. A sybil farm must then finance hundreds of idle bonds and carry them across a tundra of zero-reward epochs before one vote counts, so attack cost scales with voices while honest return stays linear. Reputation should flow like nectar from a lagoon: pooled, shared, withdrawn only against peer confirmation.
